notes.title: Doomsday Valley just launched on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[b]The Mystery of Doomsday Valley just launched on Kickstarter! [/b]

Calling all undead adventurers! We have a new quest for you. Champy demands your obedience!

Find a shovel and a bottle of ink. Combine the ink with the bones you just dug up from the shallow grave. Use it on the cheese grater and you get a sharp bone with ink. Use this in order to write letters to everyone  you know about this new upcoming game Doomsday Valley. I hear they just launched a Kickstarter and it is crucial they get funded!


Together we can make this game a reality. We need every hand on board for this one!
Make sure to check out the campaign right away as there are a few limited rewards. 

It’s a mystery point and click game with hand-drawn animations and object-based puzzles. There is a playable demo if you want to take it out for a spin before you pledge.


[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/trueascension/the-mystery-of-doomsday-valley]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/trueascension/the-mystery-of-doomsday-valley[/url]

notes.title: Play the Demo! (The Mystery of Doomsday Valley)
notes.content:
[b]Hello all undead servants! [/b]

The studio behind [b]Champy the Useless Vampire[/b] is launching a new project called The Mystery of Doomsday Valley. Here is the Steam release from that game - enjoy!

----------

Today we [b]release a demo[/b] of our beloved new game -[b] The Mystery of Doomsday Valley.[/b] Take it out for a spin - the closed beta testers have responded well so far and seems to like the direction. That is what they are telling us anyway...

[b]Demo[/b]
This demo showcases what we want to achieve with Doomsday Valley, but it should be viewed as a work in progress and an early version. The final product will be even better and more polished, but this will give you a first impression about how the game will play.


Link for easy access:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3687330


[b]Kickstarter[/b]
We will launch a kickstarter for this game in a few days, on[b] Tuesday the 13/5[/b] 2025. So be ready to back the project if you like what you see. Everything helps - if you can help us spread the word on social media or other venues we would be very grateful.

If you haven't already - go to [url=www.doomsdayvalley.com]www.doomsdayvalley.com[/url] and sign up for the Kickstarter. 

We are very happy to release this demo and are ready to do an interesting Kickstarter campaign. I hope you will join us for this adventure. Remember - something is happening to the poor citizens of Doomsday Valley and you are the only one with the power to help them!

Best regards / 
Pierre Nilsson and Karl Längberg
True Ascension Game Studio

notes.title: Champy the Useless Vampire - Fixes and Adjustments!
notes.content:
We've made some quality-of-life improvements to our beloved game, [i]Champy the Useless Vampire[/i], and fixed a few issues along the way. We're committed to keeping this little gem undead for a long time, continuing to refine and improve it.

If you spot anything that isn't working as intended, let us know in the forums! While we can't fix everything, we always give it our best shot—and most of the time, the issues get resolved.

Enjoy!


[b]Changelog:[/b]

[b]Fixes[/b]
The game got stuck when pushing the inventory button in certain closeups and zoom-in puzzles.
There was a bug with the bird that made Champy walk out of frame and get stuck in a loop.
Dialogues sometimes did not progress correctly when one line was skipped.

[i]Steam only:[/i]
The Steam achievement “Master Puzzler” is now possible to get if you start a new game even if you failed it the first time

[b]Additions[/b]
Added a choice in the settings to enable subtitles background (default: enabled)
Added a point of interest in the pub scene
Added a point of interest in the hallway scene
Added a name to the Credits

[b]Adjustments [/b]
Adjusted the size and position of Champy’s subtitles frame
Adjusted position for some character’s text frames
Adjusted Bat flightpath in Hallway
Adjusted the Secret Society Puzzle maximum moves from 5 to 7
Adjusted the Museum Puzzle combination and visual hint
Adjusted a SFX in the balcony scene
Adjusted the z-value for Inky’s aquarium
Adjusted small timings and animations in the boss-battle

notes.title: The Mystery of Doomsday Valley pre-launch page is now LIVE!
notes.content:
[h3]The Mystery of Doomsday Valley pre-launch page is now LIVE![/h3]

Since Champy the Useless Vampire launched we have been working on new ideas for a mystery game. We are now happy to reveal the name, cover art and some of the characters.

You can read more on the[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/trueascension/the-mystery-of-doomsday-valley] pre-launch Kickstarter page for Doomsday Valley[/url]. When the kickstarter launches there will also be a playable demo for the game! So make sure to stay connected by clicking the "Notify me on launch" and learn more about the game.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857763/18009b2ccb8064a82d2b819fe81aac9302729214.png[/img]

We have listened to feedback and identified a couple of areas where we want to up our game (pun intended). Doomsday Valley will feature interesting characters who will have depth and personality and they will have a bigger role in the overarching narrative. The game will be longer (a couple of hours playtime) and it will lean more on mystery and investigations and less on magic and monsters.

Check out the Kickstarter pre-launch at [url=www.doomsdayvalley.com]DoomsdayValley.com[/url]

We believe this new game will have all the fun and cute from Champy the Useless Vampire but also mystery and investigation.  So make sure to stay connected by clicking the "Notify me on launch" button on the pre-launch site.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857763/c559ca0fe2002ed8b9d8ae913bb42e71c6ac8593.png[/img]

notes.title: Achievement Unlocked!
notes.content:
We are introducing achievements! If you have craved a new playthrough of Champy the Useless Vampire, this is your moment! 

You will now be rewarded with an achievment when you investigate certain areas, solve puzzles on the first try and mostly just by playing the game. It is a quite linear narrative-driven puzzle game after all.

So make yourself a nice cup of cocoa and help Champy fetch the Holy Grail one more time! Or if your still havn't had the pleasure yet, this is the perfect moment to allocate some time to this cute little vampire game.

Good Luck!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857763/deeed8486dc49fa150fe0f9c39569e617acddc99.png[/img]

notes.title: New languages: French, Portuguese and Polish!
notes.content:
We sent Champy on a trip around the world to find skilled translators who could help us bring this fang-tastic adventure game to an even greater audience. He quickly found three suitable candidates and after just a few days of constantly annoying them by sleeping in their wardrobe,  leaving (s)teak-out bags everywhere and trying (and failing) to mind-control them, they all gave in and promised to help out.

So to summarise his trip: no one died, Champy got a well-deserved break from the evil cultists, the game now has seven(!) supported languages and Zara got to see the Eiffel Tower, the Wieliczka salt mine and the Amazon rainforest. (She was not impressed)

-

We have also fixed some issues with the game and changed how the game saves data in order to make sure everything works as intended.

Enjoy!

notes.title: One Month Anniversary - More Languages Soon
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857763/f9e5d8c60636e015df1f18000e7d963322a0df6b.png[/img]

Champy has now been on Steam for one month. Time does, just like Champy, fly.

In order for more players to be able to enjoy Champy the Useless Vampire in their preferred language, French, Polish and Portuguese languages will soon be added. So keep an eye out for our next update, it should be right around the corner.

Thanks for all the feedback, reviews and wishlists we have received, it all helps making the game better and for more people to find it. We have also noticed a few words that players use to describe the game, for example whimsical and fast-paced. We absolutely love it!

So if you feel in the mood for a whimsical fast-paced halloween-themed point-and-click adventure game, this game might be for you.

notes.title: First week on Steam
notes.content:
Greetings, adventurer!

Champy the Useless Vampire has now been live for a week and what a week it has been. We have been bombarded with suggestions, reviews, pleas for translations, bugreports, screenshots and all kinds of press coverage. It has been...a lot. 

We are happy that so many has found this game and taken it out for a spin. It seems Champy has built up quite a fanbase already - we never hear a bad word about him. Everyone seems to just go along with all the nonsense he is up to and...enjoy it? 


Mostly we have been working behind the scenes, deep deep in the code of the game, barely glimpsing the sun. What lovecraftian horrors we found down there we will not speak of, but it will take time before our programmer is able to feel love again. But as with gardening, the only way to get things done is getting your hands dirty, and now things are better, brighter and more stable. And we do not hesitate to go another round with the monsters lurking in the deep.


We are committed to this game and will not stop until we are satisfied it has reached it's full potential. One step in that direction is to make sure lots of players can enjoy the game in their preferred language. Because of this we have decided to add three additional languages in the next big update sometime in March. Yay!!


If you feel the need to show your love for Champy the Useless Vampire with an animated gif, our [url=https://discord.gg/EhMXdBn5]Discord[/url] is where we will see it and give it a thumbs up. Come have a chat - we are not a cat. Eh... right.

notes.title: Improvements: adding items
notes.content:
We have improved how the game handles new inventory objects, making sure they are added correctly. This should result in a more reliable inventory. 
We have also improved the cleanup process and adjusted Champy's level of uselessness. He is now less useless than he was before, but still pretty useless (by popular demand).

notes.title: The german wig conundrum
notes.content: We have had troubles with a very specific bug concerning the wig in the theater for a while. It seems it has been very specific indeed, as it only shows up in the german translation and for a long time passed under the radar of the more english-inclined developers. This update should put a nail in that particular coffin for now.
